articles.highlight: 这是一个活生生的、充满野性生机的隐喻，关乎每个文明的命运，关乎自然以曲折韧性始终获胜的顽强。

en.failureAnalysis: The idea may fail because the demand is unproven and chat-based interaction remains the default; a new GUI paradigm needs high education costs and real engineering validation before it can gain distribution.
en.title: Show HN: What should the GUI for AI agents look like?
